skill.name: bnbchain-mcp
skill.description: Guides setup and safe use of the BNB Chain MCP server. Covers read-only queries, write tools, ERC-8004 agent registration, Greenfield tools, private key handling, and network selection.
skill.summary: Use BNB Chain MCP tools for EVM, ERC-8004, and Greenfield workflows.
skill.author: internet-court

security_audit.summary: The skill is primarily documentation for configuring and using BNB Chain MCP tools, and many markdown backtick findings are false positives. Confirmed risks remain because the skill runs an npm MCP server, handles private keys, and enables irreversible blockchain writes. No prompt injection or malicious exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Pin @bnb-chain/mcp to a reviewed version and document how users can verify the package before installation.

remediation.issue: Write tools require wallet private keys.
remediation.suggestion: Recommend read-only mode by default, separate low-value signing wallets, and secret storage outside chat transcripts.

remediation.issue: State-changing blockchain calls can be irreversible.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation of network, recipient, contract, amount, and function before any write call.

remediation.issue: Tool references allow privateKey parameters in prompts.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer environment or wallet-manager configuration and warn users not to paste private keys into chat or tool arguments.

semantic_findings.title: Irreversible Blockchain Write Capability
semantic_findings.description: The skill directs use of transfer, approval, contract write, ERC-8004, and Greenfield write tools. Mistaken calls can move assets, grant spending rights, or disable refund behavior permanently.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited lines explicitly list write operations, required confirmation, and an irreversible Greenfield action. This is a business-logic risk, not evidence of malicious intent.

content.value_statement: Developers need clear MCP setup and safe tool selection for BNB Chain work. This skill explains server configuration, tool parameters, and transaction safeguards.
actual_capabilities: Configure the bnbchain-mcp server with npx in MCP clients.
Explain read-only tools and write tools that require PRIVATE_KEY.
Map EVM tools for blocks, transactions, balances, contracts, tokens, and NFTs.
Describe ERC-8004 agent registration, lookup, wallet, and URI tools.
Outline Greenfield bucket, object, folder, account, and payment tools.
Reference MCP prompts for block, transaction, address, token, contract, and network analysis.
limitations: It does not include the MCP server implementation code.
State-changing actions require user-provided credentials and explicit network selection.
Tool names and parameters may vary by installed MCP server version.
It cannot reverse a signed blockchain transaction or approval.

use_cases.title: Set up BNB Chain MCP access
use_cases.description: Configure the MCP server, choose stdio or SSE mode, and understand where credentials belong.

use_cases.title: Query EVM chain data
use_cases.description: Select tools for blocks, transactions, balances, contract reads, token data, and NFT checks.

use_cases.title: Plan guarded write workflows
use_cases.description: Prepare transfers, approvals, contract writes, ERC-8004 updates, or Greenfield actions with explicit confirmation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Begin With Read-Only Setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup without a signing key
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the bnbchain-mcp skill to configure read-only BNB Chain MCP access. Explain the server setup, supported networks, and tools that do not need PRIVATE_KEY.

prompt_templates.title: Choose the Right Query Tool
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the bnbchain-mcp references to choose tools for analyzing this transaction, address, token, and contract. Explain required parameters and network choices.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an ERC-8004 Registration
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ERC-8004 reference to plan agent registration. List the required metadata, network choice, confirmation checks, and read-only verification tools.

prompt_templates.title: Review a High-Risk Write Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the bnbchain-mcp skill to review this planned write operation. Check network, signer, recipient, amount, contract function, approval scope, and rollback limits.

output_examples.input: I want to inspect a BSC transaction hash.
output_examples.output: Use the transaction analysis prompt or receipt tool with the BSC network. No private key is needed for this read-only task.

output_examples.input: I need to register my MCP server as an ERC-8004 agent.
output_examples.output: Prepare the agent metadata URI, choose the exact network, confirm signer ownership, then call the registration tool only after confirmation.

output_examples.input: I want to upload a file to Greenfield mainnet.
output_examples.output: Confirm the mainnet target, bucket name, file path, and signing wallet. Treat the action as a write that requires PRIVATE_KEY handling.

best_practices: Start in read-only mode and leave PRIVATE_KEY empty until a write is required.
Ask for an explicit network before every transfer, approval, contract write, ERC-8004 update, or Greenfield write.
Pin and review the MCP server package version before using it with real funds.
anti_patterns: Do not paste private keys into chat, logs, or reusable prompt text.
Do not default write operations to BSC mainnet when the user omits a network.
Do not use unlimited token approvals or unreviewed contract writes with production wallets.

faq.question: Does this skill require a private key?
faq.answer: Read-only tools do not require a private key. Transfers, approvals, contract writes, ERC-8004 writes, and Greenfield writes do require signing credentials.

faq.question: Which MCP clients can use it?
faq.answer: The skill describes MCP server configuration for clients such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex environments that support MCP.

faq.question: Can it query chains other than BNB Chain?
faq.answer: The references mention BSC, opBNB, Ethereum, Base, Polygon, and supported testnets where the MCP server exposes those networks.

faq.question: Can it register an ERC-8004 agent?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents the registration, metadata URI, lookup, wallet, and URI update tools for ERC-8004 agent workflows.

faq.question: Does it support Greenfield?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers bucket, object, folder, account, and payment tools for Greenfield testnet and mainnet workflows.

faq.question: What is the main safety concern?
faq.answer: The main concern is combining private keys with irreversible blockchain write tools. Confirm network, amount, recipient, and contract details every time.
